name: Sunnyside Solar
old_description: We are not only experienced in design and building of solar panel systems but of sustainability and energy awareness first. Properly sized systems have the best return on investment. We prefer products with longevity and quality.
about:
Sunnyside Solar is based in Guilford, Vermont. Founded by solar pioneers Richard Gottlieb and Carol Levin, the company has operated for nearly 40 years, providing solar energy solutions across Vermont and New England. It is a family-owned business, currently led by Joseph and Rosemary Mangum, who continue the legacy on their homestead after relocating from a previous location near Chelsea Royal.

The company designs and installs solar electric systems, including utility grid-connected, off-grid, and battery backup configurations, as well as LED lighting. They emphasize properly sized systems for optimal return on investment and offer both new and used-but-reputable equipment to meet varying budgets. Their services cover design, installation, and energy awareness consulting.

Sunnyside Solar serves residential and commercial customers seeking affordable and reliable solar energy, with a focus on off-grid applications and grid-tied systems throughout New England. Their clientele includes homeowners, homesteaders, and businesses looking for sustainable energy independence.

The company differentiates itself by designing systems based on customer need rather than upselling, a philosophy encapsulated in their "design by need, not greed" approach. They prioritize sustainability, energy awareness, and long-lasting products, aiming to protect the environment for future generations.

name: Sunpol Solar
old_description: This page was written and reviewed by the SunPol Solar team in Avon, Connecticut. We are an independent solar company and solar installer founded in 2023, specializing in residential solar panel installations across Connecticut and Massachusetts. Our team holds Connecticut Home Improvement Contractor License HIC-0698394 and maintains BBB accreditation.
about:
SunPol Solar is an independent residential solar installer headquartered in Newington, Connecticut. The company was founded in 2024 with a focus on reducing household energy costs so families can redirect savings toward what matters most to them. No individual founders are named in public materials.

The firm designs, permits, and installs rooftop solar arrays and Tesla Powerwall 3 battery storage systems for homeowners across Connecticut and Massachusetts. It manages the full project lifecycle — engineering, town permitting, utility interconnection, and ongoing monitoring — and offers three financing paths: a prepaid solar lease with a single upfront payment and 25 years of included maintenance, a power purchase agreement with no upfront cost, and a traditional cash purchase. To date, SunPol has completed more than 100 installations.

SunPol serves residential customers in all 169 Connecticut towns and throughout Massachusetts. Its systems are sized to each home’s actual electricity usage, and the battery backup option is frequently specified for critical loads such as medical equipment — CPAP machines, oxygen concentrators, and insulin pumps — as well as refrigeration, lighting, and Wi‑Fi during grid outages.

The company emphasizes that it owns and maintains the equipment for the full 25‑year term under its prepaid lease, providing a single point of accountability. It also highlights a pricing structure roughly 30 percent below cash purchase, premium Tier 1 panels with microinverters, and a locally based team that handles service calls directly.

name: Sunrise Electronics, Inc.
old_description: Since 1997 we've built lasting relationships by getting it right the first time, every time.
about:
Sunrise Electronics, Inc. operates from Elk Grove Village, Illinois, where it was founded in 1997. The company is family-owned and has built its business on delivering printed circuit boards with a focus on getting each order right the first time.

The company fabricates PCBs ranging from single-sided boards to 50-layer multilayer designs, including HDI, rigid-flex, and flex circuits. All manufacturing takes place in-house at its Elk Grove Village facility, covering quick-turn prototypes with 12-hour standard lead times through high-volume production runs. Capabilities include blind and buried vias, microvias down to 2 mil, controlled impedance to ±3%, and fine-line spacing down to 1 mil.

Sunrise serves aerospace, defense, and medical industries, manufacturing to IPC-A-600 Class 2 and Class 3 standards. Its ITAR-aware processes and full traceability support mission-critical programs for military and aerospace customers.

The company emphasizes quality built into the product, citing internal yields and low defect rates. Engineering support responds same business day, and the family-owned structure provides controlled processes and on-time delivery for demanding applications.

name: Superior Machine & Welding, Inc.
old_description: Superior Machine and Welding is your Alaskan Family owned full service machine shop in Anchorage. We’ve been here on Ship Ave. since 1950 keeping all the industry in the state moving forward and we don’t plan on stopping.
about:
Superior Machine & Welding operates from Anchorage, Alaska, where it has occupied a site on Ship Avenue since 1950. The business began when Jack L. Whitmore purchased a 3,400-square-foot shop and later reclaimed adjacent land from Ship Creek to expand. A 1964 addition brought the facility to 10,000 square feet, adding two Lodge & Shipley oil-country lathes and a five-ton overhead crane. Today the company is owned by WOSB-certified Jantina Lunsford, Whitmore's daughter, continuing the family-owned legacy.

The shop provides full-service machining, welding, and custom fabrication for repair and new-build work. Machining capabilities include large-bore turning (up to 40-foot workpieces), horizontal boring (five-axis and three-axis mills), vertical knee milling with gear-cutting attachments, Blanchard grinding to ±0.00038 in, vertical shaping for internal keyways, CNC turning and milling (including a custom-built four-axis Bridgeport conversion), and plasma/oxy-fuel cutting. Welding covers TIG, MIG, stick, and brazing in materials from mild steel and aluminum to exotic alloys such as Inconel, Hastelloy, and titanium. The facility also houses 40- and 160-ton hydraulic presses, horizontal and vertical band saws, and a 3D CNC programming station.

Customers span Alaska's marine, heavy-equipment, oilfield, construction, and government sectors. The shop regularly repairs cast-iron components, rebuilds shafts and bores to OEM specifications for marine and heavy-equipment applications, and machines oilfield directional-drill timing rings. Clients range from federal and state agencies to corporations and private individuals.

The company emphasizes that its local presence eliminates the long lead times and high freight costs of sourcing from the lower 48. It backs every job with a guarantee against workmanship defects and highlights its multi-generational machinist experience—over 100 combined years—as a differentiator for tackling complex geometries and difficult materials that other shops decline.

old_description: SurePoint Electronics is nestled in the high-plains town of Atwood, Kansas, and is a subsidiary of SurePoint Ag, a manufacturer of precision agriculture products. We want to be your preferred partner for OEM-Quality wire harnesses, cable assemblies, electronics, box builds, and complete turn-key electronics solutions. SurePoint Electronics was founded with the goal to bring high-quality electronics products into the precision ag market. We believe in providing solutions with reliable communication and excellent service, developing trusting relationships with our customers, and becoming a valuable partner in their operation. We are here to make you and your products successful.
about:
SurePoint Electronics operates from Atwood, Kansas, a high-plains town in Rawlins County. The company was established as a subsidiary of SurePoint Ag, a manufacturer of precision agriculture systems, with the aim of supplying high-quality electronics to the precision farming sector.

The shop produces OEM-quality wire harnesses, cable assemblies, and complete box-build electronics, using a mix of automated and hand assembly. It also applies harness braiding for durability in agricultural, automotive, and heavy-equipment applications. Every harness undergoes Cirrus computer-interfaced testing for pin-out, continuity, resistance, and full functionality. In-house engineering supports full-service development from concept through prototype to production.

While its primary customer is its parent company, SurePoint Ag, the business also serves OEMs in agriculture, automotive, and heavy equipment. It seeks to expand its external customer base in a controlled, responsible manner.

The venture was started to become a reliable, long-term partner that communicates clearly, delivers on time, and goes the extra mile on urgent projects. Its mission includes being a profitable subsidiary, a vendor of choice for electrical harnessing and controllers, and an economic engine for Rawlins County.

name: Surface Mount Depot
old_description: Our customers’ needs shape the evolution of our electronics manufacturing solutions. Combining our commitment to our customers with industry-diverse services and expertise is what makes SMD different. Experience why
about:
Surface Mount Depot, now operating as SMD, was founded in 1988 in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. The company began as a specialist in surface mount technology and has grown into a full-service contract electronics manufacturer serving industrial and high-reliability markets.

SMD provides printed circuit board assembly using both surface mount and through-hole processes, including automated placement, wave soldering, selective wave soldering, and high-reliability hand soldering. The company also produces cable and wire harness assemblies, electromechanical box builds, and offers engineering support, functional testing, and value-added services such as modification and inspection. Its facility houses advanced automated placement and inspection equipment, though specific machine models and headcount are not disclosed.

The company serves industrial customers requiring high-reliability electronics, with a focus on long-term partnerships. Many clients return for repeated projects, citing consistent points of contact and a stable workforce that includes employees who have been with the firm since its inception.

SMD differentiates itself through an ISO 9001 certification held for over two decades, ITAR compliance, and a commitment to competitive pricing and on-time delivery. The business was built on personalized customer service and the promise of high-quality, high-reliability electronics.

name: Sustainable Island Products
old_description: Sustainable Island Products is a family-owned and operated wholesale distributor serving businesses across Hawaii with eco-friendly, sustainable takeout containers. From large resorts and grocery stores to neighborhood cafés and food trucks, we work with businesses of all sizes to provide practical alternatives to single-use plastics. Our focus is on reliable service, thoughtful sourcing, and supporting a more sustainable future for Hawai‘i’s communities.
about:
Sustainable Island Products is a family-owned and operated wholesale distributor headquartered in Kailua-Kona on the island of Hawaii. Co-owners John Elkjer (CEO) and Julie Elkjer (president) lead the company with their daughter Elizabeth Elkjer as vice president of sales. The business was built on a mission to supply Hawaii's food-service operators with high-quality sustainable packaging backed by service that builds real relationships.

The distributor stocks compostable packaging, glass containers, and post-consumer paper products, moving inventory through five warehouses located across the Hawaiian Islands. A leadership team of six directors oversees operations, logistics, purchasing, and people operations, while five sales representatives cover Hawaii Island, Maui County, Oahu, and Kauai to provide statewide delivery.

Customers include large resorts, grocery chains, neighborhood cafés, coffee shops, and food trucks — essentially the full spectrum of food-service and hospitality businesses across the state. The company serves the restaurant, hotel, grocery, and mobile-food sectors with a focus on practical, eco-friendly takeout solutions.

The Elkjer family emphasizes a consultative, 'ohana'-style partnership rather than a transactional vendor relationship, aiming to help each customer grow by matching sustainable packaging to their specific operational needs.

old_description: Improving your energy efficiency and installing solar panels go hand in hand! Both contribute to lower energy bills, fewer carbon emissions, and a cleaner, healthier home. Sustainergy Cooperative believes that insulation and solar panels are powerful on their own and unbeatable together. We are the only company that specializes in both insulation and solar energy services in the Columbus & Greater Cincinnati area.
about:
Sustainergy Cooperative operates from Cincinnati, Ohio, serving the Columbus and Greater Cincinnati region. The company is structured as a worker-owned cooperative, meaning every employee has the opportunity to become a worker-owner. The founding year and founders are not publicly disclosed.

The firm provides a suite of building-envelope and renewable-energy services. Its insulation work covers attic, wall, and crawl-space installation, along with air sealing and removal of old or damaged material. Crawl-space encapsulation is backed by a ten-year warranty. On the solar side, Sustainergy designs and installs custom rooftop photovoltaic systems and integrates battery storage for backup power. The company also offers free home energy audits to identify efficiency opportunities.

Customers include homeowners and businesses across the Columbus and Greater Cincinnati area. Residential clients such as Tom C., Gary D., and Larry M. have used the cooperative for both insulation upgrades and solar installations, reporting reduced electric bills and improved comfort. Commercial projects are referenced through the “Solar for Home or Business” messaging, though specific industrial clients are not named.

Sustainergy positions itself as the only local contractor specializing in both insulation and solar, arguing that the two measures are more effective together. The worker-ownership model is cited as a differentiator, with the company stating that employees who hold a stake in the business deliver higher-quality service because their success is tied to the customer’s outcome.

name: Sustar Woodworks
old_description: At Sustar Woodworks we craft functional furniture that honors the utility of traditional Shaker design, with mid-century modern influence. Each piece is built-to-order from premium hardwoods. We invite inquiries for commissions that align with our definitive design language.
about:
Sustar Woodworks was founded in 2012 by Ian Sustar in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Raised in his father’s woodworking shop, Sustar developed an early appreciation for the craft before studying engineering and eventually returning to furniture making. The company operates from a Milwaukee workshop where each piece is designed and built.

The shop produces built-to-order furniture using North American hardwoods and time-honored joinery techniques. Every item is made individually, emphasizing construction methods chosen for integrity and longevity rather than nostalgia. The work blends Shaker utility with mid-century modern influence, resulting in pieces that feel familiar without belonging to a specific period.

Sustar Woodworks serves clients seeking custom furniture commissions, from residential to commercial settings. The company invites inquiries for projects that align with its design language, which prioritizes thoughtful proportion, honest materials, and purposeful details.

The founder’s philosophy echoes a Shaker principle: don’t make something unless it is both necessary and useful, but if it is, don’t hesitate to make it beautiful. This ethos drives a focus on furniture meant to be used, lived with, and kept for generations.
